purpose: Document-level regression anchors from SA-graded best-in-class SDDs. A best SDD MUST score in STRONG or GOOD; a WEAK/ADEQUATE score on one of these is a miscalibration alarm in the EVAL, not the SDD. These do not feed scoring; they are an out-of-band sanity check the operator can run.
provenance: SA-curated best-SDD set, shared 2026-06. SA endorsed each document as best-in-class; criterion-level mappings live in accuracy-validation-set.json under label_source=sa_exemplar.
